title: Compact self-referenced frequency comb for airborne lidar applications
description: Building on its experience with CHARM-F, the airborne demonstrator for the upcoming MERLIN mission, DLR’s Institute for Atmospheric Physics is developing a new generation of airborne differential absorption lidars for atmospheric trace gas measurements. Such measurements typically call for a very stringent long-term stability of the emitted wavelengths down to the 10-10 level, which can hardly be reached with conventional methods making use of broadened absorption lines in gas cells. Furthermore, such conventional methods can only cover narrow spectral regions in the vicinity of sufficiently strong absorption lines of the trace gas. Self-referenced optical frequency combs, used as spectral references, provide an elegant solution to these two limitations thanks to their ability to easily achieve order of magnitudes better than 10-10 long-term stability when locked to widespread and affordable RF references such as GPS-disciplined oscillators, and their ability to access any wavelength within a spectral region containing absorption lines of the trace gas of interest, provided that the comb spectrum can be enhanced in the corresponding region by optical amplification. Up to a few years ago, such devices were typically bulky and sensitive laboratory equipment but recent developments have led to the commercial availability of compact, rugged devices that can potentially be integrated into airborne lidar systems. The subject of this tender is a standalone device comprising a compact self-referenced frequency comb and the electronics and optical modules necessary to transfer the long-term stability of the comb to external continuous-wave lasers in two specific spectral regions containing absorption lines of carbon dioxide and methane.
buyer: Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt e.V. (DLR)

title: Servicii pentru Controlul calității prelucrării imaginilor satelitare folosite în controlul prin teledetecție în anul de cerere 2021
description: Agenția de Plăți și Intervenție pentru Agricultură (APIA) demarează o procedură de achiziție pentru atribuirea unui contract de Servicii pentru Controlul calității prelucrării imaginilor satelitare folosite în controlul prin teledetecție în anul de cerere 2021. În conformitate cu Regulamentul Consiliului (CE) nr. 1306/2013, Regulamentul de punere în aplicare (CE) nr. 809/2014, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, coroborat cu documentul de lucru DSCG/2014/32 pentru verificările pe teren (OTSC) și măsurarea suprafeței în conformitate cu art. 24, 25, 26, 27, 30, 31, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41 din Regulamentul (UE) nr. 809/2014 și Specificațiile Tehnice Comune CTS pentru efectuarea controalelor pe teren emise de DG AGRI - JRC, APIA a decis să folosească, pe lângă controlul prin măsurători clasice pe teren, controlul prin teledetecţie pentru controlul cererilor de sprijin depuse de către fermieri în Campania anului de cerere 2021. APIA nu poate realiza controlul calității prelucrării imaginilor satelitare cu resurse proprii, deoarece nu dispune de logistica necesară, de personal suficient și nici de softuri adecvate pentru realizarea acestui tip de control. În schimb APIA va efectua o asigurare internă a calităţii fotointerpretării (interpretare clasică și fotointerpretare) care va duce la înregistrări de control al calităţii pentru eșantionul de supracontrol pentru fermierii controlați prin teledetecție în conformitate cu prevederile Addendumului Național 2021. Asigurarea unei calități corespunzătoare privind prelucrarea imaginilor satelitare este necesară pentru a permite desfășurarea procesului de fotointerpretare, asigurându-se astfel obținerea de rezultate conforme cu parametrii specificați în documentațiile aferente Se va încheia un contract de servicii. Durata contractului: Durata în luni: 3 luni. Operatorii economici pot solicita clarificări cu un număr de 5 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractantă va elabora şi posta în SICAP răspunsul la toate solicitările de clarificări depuse în termenul de mai sus, în a 4- a zi înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor

title: 81316788-Strengthening climate-sensitive urban planning and institutional frameworks for social housing in Rwandan cities
description: The project "Climate-Sensitive and Socially Just Planning and Housing" (CSPH) seeks continuous support throughout the project life span and across its three outputs: integrated urban planning, social housing, and capacity development. Output 1 consists of participatory and climate-sensitive spatial planning processes in two unplanned neighbourhoods: one neighbourhood in the City of Kigali, the second one in the District of Kamonyi. This work package requires regular presence of the contractor's team in the respective cities throughout the duration of the contract. The contractor together with the GIZ project team, the respective districts and residents, will develop a detailed physical plan for each neighbourhood in a participatory, inclusive, climate-resilient and integrated manner. The activities to be implemented involve an assessment of existing regulations, master plans and urban structures of each neighbourhood, several workshops with neighbourhood development committees to develop a neighbourhood development strategy and respective vision. A needs assessment shall be conducted with the residents of the neighbourhood and result in a priority list of small-scale infrastructure ideas as well as mid-to-longer term project ideas that the community needs. The goal is to have a detailed physical plan for each neighbourhood that factors in climate and gender considerations ready for approval by the district council. Additionally, these planning processes shall further inform the updating or development of policies, guidelines or instructions. Furthermore, the tender involves tasks related to the construction of small-scale infrastructure in the neighbourhoods. The tasks that are part of the tender relate to the spatial and architectural planning for altogether six small-scale infrastructure interventions for communal use. The tenderer will prepare all necessary regulatory documents for the construction and draft the ToR for local subcontractors that will be responsible for the construction process itself. Additionally, for each neighbourhood, the contractor shall develop two business plans for mid-to-longer term infrastructure interventions including but not limited to cost estimation, preliminary designs, pre-feasibility studies such as climate risk assessment, environmental & social impact assessments etc.) as a basis for discussion with national or international financiers. Under Output 2, the contractor will contribute to ongoing conceptual work on social rental housing. Activities relate to the set-up of a targeting mechanism to define potential beneficiaries of social rental housing, the development of two models for low-income rental housing as well as the design of a new structure for socially inclusive, climate-sensitive housing in Rwandan cities. This also involves process advice on establishing the new structure and PR advice on public awareness campaigns to inform beneficiaries of their eligibility and the new programme/body. The 3rd Output focuses on capacity development for urban practitioners Here the current tender foresees support in defining the specific target group for capacity development activities, developing a capacity development strategy, developing curricula for trainings as well as the implementation of specific trainings or practical field trips related to the project's main focus. Overarchingly, the tender also involves activities around monitoring and evaluation activities as well as support to the mandatory reporting in line with the requirements of the project's commission party.

Hankintajärjestelmä on alustavasti voimassa 31.8.2028 saakka, voimassaoloa voidaan pidentää tai lyhentää julkaisemalla asianmukainen hakintailmoitus. Perustamisvaiheen jälkeen hankintajärjestelmä siirtyy hankintavaiheeseen ja Tilaaja voi toteuttaa hankintoja hyväksytyiltä palveluntuottajilta. -------------- Österbottens välfärdsområde begär med denna upphandlingsannons om er ansökan att delta i ett upphandlingsförfarande likt ett dynamiskt inköpssystem för upphandling av psykologtjänster. Inköpssystemet innehåller ett aktivt delområde: 1. Psykologtjänster Samtliga anbudssökande som uppfyller lämplighetskraven och lämnat in en ansökan godkänns som anbudsgivare i inköpssystemet. Under etableringsfasen genomförs inga anskaffningar inom inköpssystemet. Efter etableringsfasen är inköpssystemet i upphandlingsfasen och anskaffningar inom inköpssystemet kan genomföras.
